import JudgeProblem

def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  intro x
  -- A: x = x ◇ ((x ◇ (x ◇ x)) ◇ x)
  have A : x = x ◇ ((x ◇ (x ◇ x)) ◇ x) := h x x
  have hxM : x ◇ ((x ◇ (x ◇ x)) ◇ x) = x := A.symm
  -- Apply h with y := (x ◇ (x ◇ x)) ◇ x:
  have hM : x = x ◇ ((x ◇ (x ◇ ((x ◇ (x ◇ x)) ◇ x))) ◇ x) :=
    h x ((x ◇ (x ◇ x)) ◇ x)
  -- Collapse (x ◇ ((x ◇ (x ◇ x)) ◇ x)) → x inside.
  exact hM.trans (congrArg (fun t => x ◇ ((x ◇ t) ◇ x)) hxM)
